title: Application of Eastern Edison Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G 1/2 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 131, for approval by the Department of Public Utilties of a change in the Company's Oil Conservation Adjustment charge to be billed to the Comany's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the billing months of September, October and November, 1985. The Oil Conservation Adjustment surcharge requests the cost of conversion from oil-fired to coal-fired generation and the calculation is baed on the respective costs of burning coal and oil.
